Inventory includes each currently evidenced release/evidence condition found in these sources. No authoritative complete finding ledger covers all current release-relevant P0/P1 findings on this candidate and HEAD, so completeness and zero counts are not established.
limitations: The executable differs from the W61.1 freeze pin, so candidate-specific release runtime and external claims cannot be carried forward from the pinned bytes.
The 2026-10-06 W61.1 census and W61.3 severity ledger bind to older HEAD/candidate identities and explicitly leave census completeness or severity counts undemonstrated.
The 2026-10-07 W61.1 interim snapshot is explicitly incomplete and bound to HEAD 0ade18184a88f557983c9511c536108d17656efe.
This inventory is an evidence-backed observation set, not an assertion that no additional finding exists.
